verdict.rationale: Formant documents a built-in AI assistant for building analytics dashboards, and a plain-language fleet query interface that returns ML-driven task recommendations for people to approve. That is real in-product AI help, but the documented scope is narrow (dashboard building, querying and recommendations) rather than broad task delegation, and it rests only on brief vendor claims. Missing for 10: documented range of tasks the assistant can carry out end-to-end, detailed docs on how the assistant works, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Using built-in visualizations, custom SQL queries, or our AI assistant, you can build a rich dashboard for your devices.
Ask your fleet what's happening in plain language and get governed, ML-driven task recommendations — with people approving what happens next.
